# VitruvianGodot Assets

## 1. Source Information
- **Source Repository:** https://github.com/ibrews/VitruvianGodot
- **Origin Base:** CharMorph "Vitruvian" base by Sean Buckley & Olaf Delgado-Friedrichs
- **Repository Author:** Agile Lens

## 4. Intended Use
- Evaluated as a realistic humanoid character replacement for zombie base meshes and player viewmodels.
- Provides a genuine 52-bone humanoid skeleton for animations (walk, idle, sway, death).
